94	class VLLMSampler:
95	    """Batch sampler backed by vLLM with optional XGrammar JSON constrained decoding."""
96	
97	    def __init__(
98	        self,
99	        model_path: str,
100	        tensor_parallel_size: int = 1,
101	        max_model_len: int = 4096,
102	        gpu_memory_utilization: float = 0.90,
103	    ):
104	        """Initialise the vLLM engine.
105	
106	        Args:
107	            model_path: Path to the HuggingFace model (local or hub id).
108	            tensor_parallel_size: Number of GPUs for tensor parallelism.
109	            max_model_len: Maximum sequence length.
110	            gpu_memory_utilization: Fraction of GPU memory to reserve.
111	        """
112	        from vllm import LLM
113	
114	        self.llm = LLM(
115	            model=model_path,
116	            tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
117	            max_model_len=max_model_len,
118	            gpu_memory_utilization=gpu_memory_utilization,
119	        )
120	        self._model_path = model_path
121	        self._tokenizer = None
122	
123	    def _get_tokenizer(self):
124	        if self._tokenizer is None:
125	            from transformers import AutoTokenizer
126	            self._tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
127	                self._model_path, trust_remote_code=True,
128	            )
129	        return self._tokenizer
130	
131	    def format_chat_prompt(self, prompt: str) -> str:
132	        tokenizer = self._get_tokenizer()
133	        return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
134	            [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
135	            tokenize=False,
136	            add_generation_prompt=True,
137	            enable_thinking=False,
138	        )
139	
140	    def sample(
141	        self,
142	        prompts: list[str],
143	        n_samples: int = 8,
144	        temperature: float = 1.0,
145	        max_tokens: int = 1024,
146	        use_grammar: bool = True,
147	        use_chat_template: bool = True,
148	    ) -> list[list[str]]:
149	        """Sample *n_samples* completions for each prompt.
150	
151	        Args:
152	            prompts: Input prompt strings.
153	            n_samples: Number of independent samples per prompt.
154	            temperature: Sampling temperature (0 = greedy).
155	            max_tokens: Maximum generated tokens per sample.
156	            use_grammar: If True, enable XGrammar JSON constrained decoding.
157	            use_chat_template: If True, wrap prompts with the model's chat template.
158	
159	        Returns:
160	            Nested list of shape [len(prompts)][n_samples] containing raw output strings.
161	        """
162	        from vllm import SamplingParams
163	        from vllm.sampling_params import GuidedDecodingParams
164	
165	        if use_chat_template:
166	            prompts = [self.format_chat_prompt(p) for p in prompts]
167	
168	        guided_params = GuidedDecodingParams(json=UIE_JSON_SCHEMA) if use_grammar else None
169	
170	        params = SamplingParams(
171	            n=n_samples,
172	            temperature=temperature,
173	            max_tokens=max_tokens,
174	            guided_decoding=guided_params,
175	        )
176	
177	        request_outputs = self.llm.generate(prompts, params)
178	
179	        results: list[list[str]] = []
180	        for req_out in request_outputs:
181	            results.append([out.text for out in req_out.outputs])
182	        return results
183

186	# Prompt construction
187	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
188	
189	_NER_TEMPLATE = (
190	    "Extract named entities from the following text. "
191	    "Output a JSON object with the fields: entities, relations, events.\n\n"
192	    "Text: {text}\n"
193	    "{schema_line}"
194	    "\nOutput format: "
195	    '{{"entities": [{{"text": "...", "type": "...", "start": <int>, "end": <int>}}], '
196	    '"relations": [], "events": []}}'
197	)
198	
199	_EAE_TEMPLATE = (
200	    "Extract events (triggers and arguments) from the following text. "

202	    "Text: {text}\n"
203	    "{schema_line}"
204	    "\nOutput format: "
205	    '{{"entities": [], "relations": [], '

208	)

213	    "Text: {text}\n"
214	    "{schema_line}"

223	    "Extract all structured information (entities, relations, events) from the following text. "
224	    "Output a JSON object with the fields: entities, relations, events.\n\n"
225	    "Text: {text}\n"
226	    "{schema_line}"
227	    "\nOutput:"
228	)
229

231	    "Extract all structured information (entities and relations) from the following text. "
232	    "Output a JSON object.\n\n"
233	    "Text: {text}\n"
234	    "{schema_line}"
235	    "\nOutput format: "
236	    '{{"entities": [{{"text": "...", "type": "...", "start": <int>, "end": <int>}}], '

238	    '"head_start": <int>, "head_end": <int>, "tail_start": <int>, "tail_end": <int>}}], '

248	def build_uie_prompt(text: str, subtask: str = "ner", schema_hint: str = "", use_train_format: bool = True) -> str:
249	    """Build a UIE extraction prompt.
250	
251	    Args:
252	        text: Input sentence / passage.
253	        subtask: "ner" (entities only), "eae" (events), or "full" (all).
254	        schema_hint: Optional schema description (e.g. entity type list).
255	        use_train_format: If True, use the train-aligned template (ignores subtask).
256	
257	    Returns:
258	        Formatted prompt string.
259	    """
260	    if use_train_format:
261	        schema_line = f"{schema_hint}\n" if schema_hint else ""
262	        return _TRAIN_ALIGNED_TEMPLATE.format(text=text, schema_line=schema_line)
263	
264	    schema_line = f"Schema: {schema_hint}\n" if schema_hint else ""
265	
266	    if subtask == "ner":
267	        template = _NER_TEMPLATE
268	    elif subtask == "re":
269	        template = _RE_TEMPLATE
270	    elif subtask == "eae":
271	        template = _EAE_TEMPLATE
272	    elif subtask == "full":
273	        template = _FULL_TEMPLATE
274	    else:
275	        raise ValueError(f"subtask must be 'ner', 're', 'eae', or 'full', got '{subtask}'")
276	
277	    return template.format(text=text, schema_line=schema_line)

280	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
281	# Output parsing
282	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
283	
284	def parse_extraction_output(raw_output: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
285	    """Parse a model output string into an Extraction dict.
286	
287	    Handles JSON parsing (XGrammar guarantees valid JSON, but we still guard),
288	    field validation, and type coercion for start/end.
289	
290	    Args:
291	        raw_output: Raw model completion text.
292	
293	    Returns:
294	        Extraction dict with keys entities, relations, events.
295	    """
296	    raw = raw_output.strip()
297	    try:
298	        data = json.loads(raw)
299	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
300	        # Attempt to extract the first JSON object from the string
301	        start = raw.find("{")
302	        end = raw.rfind("}")
303	        if start != -1 and end != -1 and end > start:
304	            try:
305	                data = json.loads(raw[start:end + 1])
306	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
307	                return dict(_EMPTY_EXTRACTION)
308	        else:
309	            return dict(_EMPTY_EXTRACTION)
310	
311	    if not isinstance(data, dict):
312	        return dict(_EMPTY_EXTRACTION)
313	
314	    entities = _validate_entities(data.get("entities", []))
315	    relations = _validate_relations(data.get("relations", []))
316	    events = _validate_events(data.get("events", []))
317	
318	    return {"entities": entities, "relations": relations, "events": events}
319	
320	
321	def _validate_entities(raw: Any) -> list[dict]:
322	    if not isinstance(raw, list):
323	        return []
324	    validated = []
325	    for e in raw:
326	        if not isinstance(e, dict):
327	            continue
328	        try:
329	            validated.append({
330	                "text": str(e["text"]),
331	                "type": str(e["type"]),
332	                "start": int(e["start"]),
333	                "end": int(e["end"]),
334	            })
335	        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
336	            continue
337	    return validated
338	
339	
340	def _validate_relations(raw: Any) -> list[dict]:
341	    if not isinstance(raw, list):
342	        return []
343	    validated = []
344	    for r in raw:
345	        if not isinstance(r, dict):
346	            continue
347	        try:
348	            validated.append({
349	                "head": str(r["head"]),
350	                "tail": str(r["tail"]),
351	                "type": str(r["type"]),
352	                "head_start": int(r["head_start"]),
353	                "head_end": int(r["head_end"]),
354	                "tail_start": int(r["tail_start"]),
355	                "tail_end": int(r["tail_end"]),
356	            })
357	        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
358	            continue
359	    return validated
360	
361	
362	def _validate_events(raw: Any) -> list[dict]:
363	    if not isinstance(raw, list):
364	        return []
365	    validated = []
366	    for ev in raw:
367	        if not isinstance(ev, dict):
368	            continue
369	        trigger_raw = ev.get("trigger")
370	        if not isinstance(trigger_raw, dict):
371	            continue
372	        try:
373	            trigger = {
374	                "text": str(trigger_raw["text"]),
375	                "type": str(trigger_raw["type"]),
376	                "start": int(trigger_raw["start"]),
377	                "end": int(trigger_raw["end"]),
378	            }
379	        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
380	            continue
381	        arguments = []
382	        for arg in ev.get("arguments", []):
383	            if not isinstance(arg, dict):
384	                continue
385	            try:
386	                arguments.append({
387	                    "text": str(arg["text"]),
388	                    "role": str(arg["role"]),
389	                    "start": int(arg["start"]),
390	                    "end": int(arg["end"]),
391	                })
392	            except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
393	                continue
394	        validated.append({"trigger": trigger, "arguments": arguments})
395	    return validated
396	
397	
398	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
399	# Batch sampling pipeline
400	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
401	
402	def run_sampling_pipeline(
403	    sampler: VLLMSampler,
404	    instances: list[dict],
405	    n_samples: int = 8,
406	    temperature: float = 1.0,
407	    max_tokens: int = 1024,
408	    subtask: str = "ner",
409	    schema_hint: str = "",
410	    use_grammar: bool = True,
411	    use_chat_template: bool = True,
412	    use_train_format: bool = True,
413	    output_path: str | None = None,
414	) -> list[dict]:
415	    """Full sampling pipeline: build prompts -> batch sample -> parse -> save.
416	
417	    Also performs a single greedy decoding pass (temperature=0, n=1) as baseline.
418	
419	    Args:
420	        sampler: Initialised VLLMSampler.
421	        instances: Instance dicts from data_utils (must have "id", "text", and gold fields).
422	        n_samples: Number of stochastic samples per instance.
423	        temperature: Sampling temperature for stochastic samples.
424	        max_tokens: Maximum generated tokens.
425	        subtask: "ner", "eae", or "full".
426	        schema_hint: Optional schema description.
427	        use_grammar: Whether to use XGrammar constrained decoding.
428	        use_chat_template: Whether to wrap prompts with the model's chat template.
429	        use_train_format: If True, use the train-aligned prompt template.
430	        output_path: If provided, save results to this JSONL path.
431	
432	    Returns:
433	        List of SampledInstance dicts.
434	    """
435	    prompts = [build_uie_prompt(inst["text"], subtask=subtask, schema_hint=schema_hint,
436	                                use_train_format=use_train_format)
437	               for inst in instances]
438	
439	    # Stochastic sampling
440	    raw_samples = sampler.sample(
441	        prompts,
442	        n_samples=n_samples,
443	        temperature=temperature,
444	        max_tokens=max_tokens,
445	        use_grammar=use_grammar,
446	        use_chat_template=use_chat_template,
447	    )
448	
449	    # Greedy decoding
450	    raw_greedy = sampler.sample(
451	        prompts,
452	        n_samples=1,
453	        temperature=0.0,
454	        max_tokens=max_tokens,
455	        use_grammar=use_grammar,
456	        use_chat_template=use_chat_template,
457	    )
458	
459	    # Assemble SampledInstance list
460	    sampled_instances: list[dict] = []
461	    for idx, inst in enumerate(instances):
462	        gold = {
463	            "entities": inst.get("entities", []),
464	            "relations": inst.get("relations", []),
465	            "events": inst.get("events", []),
466	        }
467	        parsed_samples = [parse_extraction_output(s) for s in raw_samples[idx]]
468	        parsed_greedy = parse_extraction_output(raw_greedy[idx][0])
469	
470	        sampled_instances.append({
471	            "id": inst.get("id", str(idx)),
472	            "text": inst["text"],
473	            "gold": gold,
474	            "samples": parsed_samples,
475	            "greedy": parsed_greedy,
476	        })
477	
478	    if output_path:
479	        save_sampled_results(sampled_instances, output_path)
480	
481	    return sampled_instances
482	
483	
484	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
485	# I/O helpers
486	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
487	
488	def save_sampled_results(sampled: list[dict], path: str) -> None:
489	    """Save sampled results as JSONL.
490	
491	    Args:
492	        sampled: List of SampledInstance dicts.
493	        path: Output file path.
494	    """
495	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
496	    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
497	        for inst in sampled:
498	            f.write(json.dumps(inst, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
499	
500	
501	def load_sampled_results(path: str) -> list[dict]:
502	    """Load sampled results from a JSONL file.
503	
504	    Args:
505	        path: Path to a JSONL file of SampledInstance dicts.
506	
507	    Returns:
508	        List of SampledInstance dicts.
509	    """
510	    instances = []
511	    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
512	        for line in f:
513	            line = line.strip()
514	            if line:
515	                instances.append(json.loads(line))
516	    return instances

"""Multi-sample inference module for structured IE with vLLM + XGrammar constrained decoding.

Provides VLLMSampler for batch sampling, prompt construction for UIE tasks,
and a full pipeline that produces SampledInstance dicts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from typing import Any


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UIE JSON schema for XGrammar constrained decoding
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

UIE_JSON_SCHEMA: dict[str, Any] = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "entities": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "text": {"type": "string"},
                    "type": {"type": "string"},
                    "start": {"type": "integer"},
                    "end": {"type": "integer"},
                },
                "required": ["text", "type", "start", "end"],
            },
        },
        "relations": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "head": {"type": "string"},
                    "tail": {"type": "string"},
                    "type": {"type": "string"},
                    "head_start": {"type": "integer"},
                    "head_end": {"type": "integer"},
                    "tail_start": {"type": "integer"},
                    "tail_end": {"type": "integer"},
                },
                "required": ["head", "tail", "type", "head_start", "head_end",
                             "tail_start", "tail_end"],
            },
        },
        "events": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "trigger": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                            "text": {"type": "string"},
                            "type": {"type": "string"},
                            "start": {"type": "integer"},
                            "end": {"type": "integer"},
                        },
                        "required": ["text", "type", "start", "end"],
                    },
                    "arguments": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "properties": {
                                "text": {"type": "string"},
                                "role": {"type": "string"},
                                "start": {"type": "integer"},
                                "end": {"type": "integer"},
                            },
                            "required": ["text", "role", "start", "end"],
                        },
                    },
                },
                "required": ["trigger", "arguments"],
            },
        },
    },
    "required": ["entities", "relations", "events"],
}

_EMPTY_EXTRACTION: dict[str, list] = {"entities": [], "relations": [], "events": []}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VLLMSampler
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class VLLMSampler:
    """Batch sampler backed by vLLM with optional XGrammar JSON constrained decoding."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        model_path: str,
        tensor_parallel_size: int = 1,
        max_model_len: int = 4096,
        gpu_memory_utilization: float = 0.90,
    ):
        """Initialise the vLLM engine.

        Args:
            model_path: Path to the HuggingFace model (local or hub id).
            tensor_parallel_size: Number of GPUs for tensor parallelism.
            max_model_len: Maximum sequence length.
            gpu_memory_utilization: Fraction of GPU memory to reserve.
        """
        from vllm import LLM

        self.llm = LLM(
            model=model_path,
            tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
            max_model_len=max_model_len,
            gpu_memory_utilization=gpu_memory_utilization,
        )
        self._model_path = model_path
        self._tokenizer = None

    def _get_tokenizer(self):
        if self._tokenizer is None:
            from transformers import AutoTokenizer
            self._tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
                self._model_path, trust_remote_code=True,
            )
        return self._tokenizer

    def format_chat_prompt(self, prompt: str) -> str:
        tokenizer = self._get_tokenizer()
        return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
            tokenize=False,
            add_generation_prompt=True,
            enable_thinking=False,
        )

    def sample(
        self,
        prompts: list[str],
        n_samples: int = 8,
        temperature: float = 1.0,
        max_tokens: int = 1024,
        use_grammar: bool = True,
        use_chat_template: bool = True,
    ) -> list[list[str]]:
        """Sample *n_samples* completions for each prompt.

        Args:
            prompts: Input prompt strings.
            n_samples: Number of independent samples per prompt.
            temperature: Sampling temperature (0 = greedy).
            max_tokens: Maximum generated tokens per sample.
            use_grammar: If True, enable XGrammar JSON constrained decoding.
            use_chat_template: If True, wrap prompts with the model's chat template.

        Returns:
            Nested list of shape [len(prompts)][n_samples] containing raw output strings.
        """
        from vllm import SamplingParams
        from vllm.sampling_params import GuidedDecodingParams

        if use_chat_template:
            prompts = [self.format_chat_prompt(p) for p in prompts]

        guided_params = GuidedDecodingParams(json=UIE_JSON_SCHEMA) if use_grammar else None

        params = SamplingParams(
            n=n_samples,
            temperature=temperature,
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            guided_decoding=guided_params,
        )

        request_outputs = self.llm.generate(prompts, params)

        results: list[list[str]] = []
        for req_out in request_outputs:
            results.append([out.text for out in req_out.outputs])
        return results


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prompt construction
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_NER_TEMPLATE = (
    "Extract named entities from the following text. "
    "Output a JSON object with the fields: entities, relations, events.\n\n"
    "Text: {text}\n"
    "{schema_line}"
    "\nOutput format: "
    '{{"entities": [{{"text": "...", "type": "...", "start": <int>, "end": <int>}}], '
    '"relations": [], "events": []}}'
)

_EAE_TEMPLATE = (
    "Extract events (triggers and arguments) from the following text. "
    "Output a JSON object with the fields: entities, relations, events.\n\n"
    "Text: {text}\n"
    "{schema_line}"
    "\nOutput format: "
    '{{"entities": [], "relations": [], '
    '"events": [{{"trigger": {{"text": "...", "type": "...", "start": <int>, "end": <int>}}, '
    '"arguments": [{{"text": "...", "role": "...", "start": <int>, "end": <int>}}]}}]}}'
)

_RE_TEMPLATE = (
    "Extract all relations (head entity, relation type, tail entity) from the following text. "
    "Output a JSON object with the fields: entities, relations, events.\n\n"
    "Text: {text}\n"
    "{schema_line}"
    "\nOutput format: "
    '{{"entities": [], '
    '"relations": [{{"head": "...", "tail": "...", "type": "...", '
    '"head_start": <int>, "head_end": <int>, "tail_start": <int>, "tail_end": <int>}}], '
    '"events": []}}'
)

_FULL_TEMPLATE = (
    "Extract all structured information (entities, relations, events) from the following text. "
    "Output a JSON object with the fields: entities, relations, events.\n\n"
    "Text: {text}\n"
    "{schema_line}"
    "\nOutput:"
)

_TRAIN_ALIGNED_TEMPLATE = (
    "Extract all structured information (entities and relations) from the following text. "
    "Output a JSON object.\n\n"
    "Text: {text}\n"
    "{schema_line}"
    "\nOutput format: "
    '{{"entities": [{{"text": "...", "type": "...", "start": <int>, "end": <int>}}], '
    '"relations": [{{"head": "...", "tail": "...", "type": "...", '
    '"head_start": <int>, "head_end": <int>, "tail_start": <int>, "tail_end": <int>}}], '
    '"events": []}}'
)

SCIERC_SCHEMA_HINT = (
    "Entity types: Generic, Material, Method, Metric, OtherScientificTerm, Task\n"
    "Relation types: COMPARE, CONJUNCTION, EVALUATE-FOR, FEATURE-OF, HYPONYM-OF, PART-OF, USED-FOR"
)


def build_uie_prompt(text: str, subtask: str = "ner", schema_hint: str = "", use_train_format: bool = True) -> str:
    """Build a UIE extraction prompt.

    Args:
        text: Input sentence / passage.
        subtask: "ner" (entities only), "eae" (events), or "full" (all).
        schema_hint: Optional schema description (e.g. entity type list).
        use_train_format: If True, use the train-aligned template (ignores subtask).

    Returns:
        Formatted prompt string.
    """
    if use_train_format:
        schema_line = f"{schema_hint}\n" if schema_hint else ""
        return _TRAIN_ALIGNED_TEMPLATE.format(text=text, schema_line=schema_line)

    schema_line = f"Schema: {schema_hint}\n" if schema_hint else ""

    if subtask == "ner":
        template = _NER_TEMPLATE
    elif subtask == "re":
        template = _RE_TEMPLATE
    elif subtask == "eae":
        template = _EAE_TEMPLATE
    elif subtask == "full":
        template = _FULL_TEMPLATE
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"subtask must be 'ner', 're', 'eae', or 'full', got '{subtask}'")

    return template.format(text=text, schema_line=schema_line)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output parsing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def parse_extraction_output(raw_output: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse a model output string into an Extraction dict.

    Handles JSON parsing (XGrammar guarantees valid JSON, but we still guard),
    field validation, and type coercion for start/end.

    Args:
        raw_output: Raw model completion text.

    Returns:
        Extraction dict with keys entities, relations, events.
    """
    raw = raw_output.strip()
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        # Attempt to extract the first JSON object from the string
        start = raw.find("{")
        end = raw.rfind("}")
        if start != -1 and end != -1 and end > start:
            try:
                data = json.loads(raw[start:end + 1])
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                return dict(_EMPTY_EXTRACTION)
        else:
            return dict(_EMPTY_EXTRACTION)

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return dict(_EMPTY_EXTRACTION)

    entities = _validate_entities(data.get("entities", []))
    relations = _validate_relations(data.get("relations", []))
    events = _validate_events(data.get("events", []))

    return {"entities": entities, "relations": relations, "events": events}


def _validate_entities(raw: Any) -> list[dict]:
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        return []
    validated = []
    for e in raw:
        if not isinstance(e, dict):
            continue
        try:
            validated.append({
                "text": str(e["text"]),
                "type": str(e["type"]),
                "start": int(e["start"]),
                "end": int(e["end"]),
            })
        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
            continue
    return validated


def _validate_relations(raw: Any) -> list[dict]:
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        return []
    validated = []
    for r in raw:
        if not isinstance(r, dict):
            continue
        try:
            validated.append({
                "head": str(r["head"]),
                "tail": str(r["tail"]),
                "type": str(r["type"]),
                "head_start": int(r["head_start"]),
                "head_end": int(r["head_end"]),
                "tail_start": int(r["tail_start"]),
                "tail_end": int(r["tail_end"]),
            })
        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
            continue
    return validated


def _validate_events(raw: Any) -> list[dict]:
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        return []
    validated = []
    for ev in raw:
        if not isinstance(ev, dict):
            continue
        trigger_raw = ev.get("trigger")
        if not isinstance(trigger_raw, dict):
            continue
        try:
            trigger = {
                "text": str(trigger_raw["text"]),
                "type": str(trigger_raw["type"]),
                "start": int(trigger_raw["start"]),
                "end": int(trigger_raw["end"]),
            }
        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
            continue
        arguments = []
        for arg in ev.get("arguments", []):
            if not isinstance(arg, dict):
                continue
            try:
                arguments.append({
                    "text": str(arg["text"]),
                    "role": str(arg["role"]),
                    "start": int(arg["start"]),
                    "end": int(arg["end"]),
                })
            except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
                continue
        validated.append({"trigger": trigger, "arguments": arguments})
    return validated


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Batch sampling pipeline
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_sampling_pipeline(
    sampler: VLLMSampler,
    instances: list[dict],
    n_samples: int = 8,
    temperature: float = 1.0,
    max_tokens: int = 1024,
    subtask: str = "ner",
    schema_hint: str = "",
    use_grammar: bool = True,
    use_chat_template: bool = True,
    use_train_format: bool = True,
    output_path: str | None = None,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Full sampling pipeline: build prompts -> batch sample -> parse -> save.

    Also performs a single greedy decoding pass (temperature=0, n=1) as baseline.

    Args:
        sampler: Initialised VLLMSampler.
        instances: Instance dicts from data_utils (must have "id", "text", and gold fields).
        n_samples: Number of stochastic samples per instance.
        temperature: Sampling temperature for stochastic samples.
        max_tokens: Maximum generated tokens.
        subtask: "ner", "eae", or "full".
        schema_hint: Optional schema description.
        use_grammar: Whether to use XGrammar constrained decoding.
        use_chat_template: Whether to wrap prompts with the model's chat template.
        use_train_format: If True, use the train-aligned prompt template.
        output_path: If provided, save results to this JSONL path.

    Returns:
        List of SampledInstance dicts.
    """
    prompts = [build_uie_prompt(inst["text"], subtask=subtask, schema_hint=schema_hint,
                                use_train_format=use_train_format)
               for inst in instances]

    # Stochastic sampling
    raw_samples = sampler.sample(
        prompts,
        n_samples=n_samples,
        temperature=temperature,
        max_tokens=max_tokens,
        use_grammar=use_grammar,
        use_chat_template=use_chat_template,
    )

    # Greedy decoding
    raw_greedy = sampler.sample(
        prompts,
        n_samples=1,
        temperature=0.0,
        max_tokens=max_tokens,
        use_grammar=use_grammar,
        use_chat_template=use_chat_template,
    )

    # Assemble SampledInstance list
    sampled_instances: list[dict] = []
    for idx, inst in enumerate(instances):
        gold = {
            "entities": inst.get("entities", []),
            "relations": inst.get("relations", []),
            "events": inst.get("events", []),
        }
        parsed_samples = [parse_extraction_output(s) for s in raw_samples[idx]]
        parsed_greedy = parse_extraction_output(raw_greedy[idx][0])

        sampled_instances.append({
            "id": inst.get("id", str(idx)),
            "text": inst["text"],
            "gold": gold,
            "samples": parsed_samples,
            "greedy": parsed_greedy,
        })

    if output_path:
        save_sampled_results(sampled_instances, output_path)

    return sampled_instances


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# I/O helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def save_sampled_results(sampled: list[dict], path: str) -> None:
    """Save sampled results as JSONL.

    Args:
        sampled: List of SampledInstance dicts.
        path: Output file path.
    """
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for inst in sampled:
            f.write(json.dumps(inst, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def load_sampled_results(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Load sampled results from a JSONL file.

    Args:
        path: Path to a JSONL file of SampledInstance dicts.

    Returns:
        List of SampledInstance dicts.
    """
    instances = []
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                instances.append(json.loads(line))
    return instances

233	    else:

242	            **st_report,
243	            "verdict": verdict,
244	            "verdict_note": "MVP verdict on single subtask; final pass requires at least one of NER/RE/EAE to meet threshold",
245	        }
246	
247	    worst_pct_zero = max(sr["sample_f1_pct_zero"] for sr in subtask_reports.values())
248	    if worst_pct_zero > 30:
249	        report["warning"] = "⚠️ >30% samples F1=0, recommend re-running at T=0.7"
250

252

254	    with open(report_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
255	        json.dump(report, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

"""MVP pilot experiment script for structured self-consistency IE.

Integrates data loading, vLLM sampling, consistency scoring, and evaluation
into a single CLI-driven pipeline. Outputs a verdict (PASS/MARGINAL/FAIL)
based on the correlation between structural consistency and per-instance F1.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import random
import sys

import numpy as np

from data_utils import load_scierc, load_ace05
from sampling import (
    VLLMSampler,
    run_sampling_pipeline,
    save_sampled_results,
    load_sampled_results,
    SCIERC_SCHEMA_HINT,
)
from consistency import compute_all_consistency_scores
from evaluation import (
    per_instance_f1,
    compute_ner_f1,
    compute_re_f1,
    compute_eae_f1,
    spearman_correlation,
    compute_sample_f1_distribution,
)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    """Parse command-line arguments."""
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="MVP pilot for structured self-consistency IE")
    p.add_argument("--model_path", type=str, required=True, help="Path to the fine-tuned model")
    p.add_argument("--data_dir", type=str, required=True, help="Dataset directory (SciERC or ACE05)")
    p.add_argument("--dataset", type=str, default="scierc", choices=["scierc", "ace05"],
                   help="Dataset name (default: scierc)")
    p.add_argument("--subtask", type=str, default="ner", choices=["ner", "re", "eae", "joint"],
                   help="Subtask (default: ner)")
    p.add_argument("--schema_hint", type=str, default="",
                   help="Schema hint string (entity/relation types). Auto-set for scierc if empty")
    p.add_argument("--use_train_format", type=lambda x: x.lower() != "false", default=True,
                   help="Use train-aligned prompt template (default: True)")
    p.add_argument("--n_samples", type=int, default=8, help="Number of samples per instance (default: 8)")
    p.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=1.0, help="Sampling temperature (default: 1.0)")
    p.add_argument("--max_tokens", type=int, default=512, help="Max generation tokens (default: 512)")
    p.add_argument("--output_dir", type=str, default="output", help="Output directory (default: output)")
    p.add_argument("--num_test", type=int, default=200, help="Max test instances (default: 200)")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42, help="Random seed (default: 42)")
    p.add_argument("--tensor_parallel", type=int, default=1, help="vLLM tensor parallel size (default: 1)")
    p.add_argument("--skip_sampling", action="store_true", help="Skip sampling, load from existing results")
    p.add_argument("--samples_path", type=str, default=None,
                   help="Path to existing sampling results (used with --skip_sampling)")
    return p.parse_args()


def _print_subtask_block(report: dict, prefix: str = "") -> None:
    """Print metrics block for a single subtask."""
    p = prefix
    print(f"  Greedy F1:      {report[f'{p}greedy_f1']:.4f}")
    print(f"  Oracle F1:      {report[f'{p}oracle_f1']:.4f}")
    print(f"  Oracle headroom:{report[f'{p}oracle_headroom']:+.4f}")
    print("-" * 60)
    print(f"  Fleiss' kappa (mean):    {report[f'{p}fleiss_kappa_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"  Soft Jaccard (mean):     {report[f'{p}soft_jaccard_mean']:.4f}")
    print("-" * 60)
    print(f"  Sample F1 (mean):        {report[f'{p}sample_f1_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"  Sample F1 (std):         {report[f'{p}sample_f1_std']:.4f}")
    print(f"  Sample F1=0 (%):         {report[f'{p}sample_f1_pct_zero']:.1f}%")
    print("-" * 60)
    corr_fk = report[f"{p}correlation_fleiss_vs_f1"]
    corr_sj = report[f"{p}correlation_softjaccard_vs_f1"]
    print(f"  Corr(fleiss_kappa, F1):  rho={corr_fk['rho']:+.4f}  p={corr_fk['p_value']:.4e}")
    print(f"  Corr(soft_jaccard, F1):  rho={corr_sj['rho']:+.4f}  p={corr_sj['p_value']:.4e}")
    beats = "YES" if report[f"{p}structural_beats_surface"] else "NO"
    print(f"  Structural > Surface:    {beats}  (delta={report[f'{p}rho_advantage']:+.4f})")


def print_report(report: dict) -> None:
    """Pretty-print the experiment report to stdout."""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("  Structured Self-Consistency IE — MVP Pilot Report")
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f"  Dataset:        {report['dataset']} / {report['subtask']}")
    print(f"  Instances:      {report['num_instances']}")
    print(f"  Samples/inst:   {report['n_samples']}")
    print(f"  Temperature:    {report['temperature']}")
    print(f"  Train format:   {report.get('use_train_format', 'N/A')}")
    print("-" * 60)

    if report["subtask"] == "joint":
        for st in ["ner", "re"]:
            print(f"\n  >>> {st.upper()} <<<")
            _print_subtask_block(report, prefix=f"{st}_")
            print()
    else:
        _print_subtask_block(report, prefix="")

    print("-" * 60)
    print(f"  Verdict:        {report['verdict']}")
    if "warning" in report:
        print(f"  {report['warning']}")
    print(f"  Note:           {report['verdict_note']}")
    print("=" * 60 + "\n")


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()

    random.seed(args.seed)
    np.random.seed(args.seed)

    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Resolve schema hint
    schema = args.schema_hint or (SCIERC_SCHEMA_HINT if args.dataset == "scierc" and args.use_train_format else "")

    # --- 1. Load data ---
    load_subtask = args.subtask if args.subtask != "joint" else "ner"
    if args.dataset == "scierc":
        data = load_scierc(args.data_dir)
    else:
        data = load_ace05(args.data_dir, subtask=load_subtask)

    test_instances = data["test"][:args.num_test]
    print(f"Loaded {len(test_instances)} test instances from {args.dataset}")

    # --- 2. Sampling (or load existing) ---
    if args.skip_sampling:
        if not args.samples_path:
            print("ERROR: --samples_path required when using --skip_sampling", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        sampled = load_sampled_results(args.samples_path)
        print(f"Loaded {len(sampled)} sampled instances from {args.samples_path}")
    else:
        sampler = VLLMSampler(
            args.model_path,
            tensor_parallel_size=args.tensor_parallel,
        )
        samples_out = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "samples.jsonl")
        sampled = run_sampling_pipeline(
            sampler,
            test_instances,
            n_samples=args.n_samples,
            temperature=args.temperature,
            max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
            subtask=args.subtask if args.subtask != "joint" else "full",
            schema_hint=schema,
            use_train_format=args.use_train_format,
            output_path=samples_out,
        )
        print(f"Sampling complete. Saved to {samples_out}")

    greedy_preds = [inst["greedy"] for inst in sampled]
    golds = [inst["gold"] for inst in sampled]

    # Determine which subtasks to evaluate
    eval_subtasks = ["ner", "re"] if args.subtask == "joint" else [args.subtask]

    # --- Per-subtask evaluation ---
    subtask_reports = {}
    for st in eval_subtasks:
        consistency = compute_all_consistency_scores(sampled, subtask=st)
        sample_f1_dist = compute_sample_f1_distribution(sampled, subtask=st)

        f1_fn = {"ner": compute_ner_f1, "re": compute_re_f1, "eae": compute_eae_f1}[st]
        greedy_metrics = f1_fn(greedy_preds, golds)
        oracle_preds = []
        for inst in sampled:
            best = max(inst["samples"], key=lambda s: per_instance_f1(s, inst["gold"], st))
            oracle_preds.append(best)
        oracle_metrics = f1_fn(oracle_preds, golds)

        greedy_f1 = greedy_metrics["f1"]
        oracle_f1 = oracle_metrics["f1"]
        oracle_headroom = oracle_f1 - greedy_f1

        instance_f1s = [per_instance_f1(pred, gold, subtask=st)
                        for pred, gold in zip(greedy_preds, golds)]

        rho_fk, p_fk = spearman_correlation(consistency["fleiss_kappa"], instance_f1s)
        rho_sj, p_sj = spearman_correlation(consistency["soft_jaccard"], instance_f1s)

        subtask_reports[st] = {
            "greedy_f1": greedy_f1,
            "oracle_f1": oracle_f1,
            "oracle_headroom": oracle_headroom,
            "fleiss_kappa_mean": float(np.mean(consistency["fleiss_kappa"])),
            "soft_jaccard_mean": float(np.mean(consistency["soft_jaccard"])),
            "correlation_fleiss_vs_f1": {"rho": rho_fk, "p_value": p_fk},
            "correlation_softjaccard_vs_f1": {"rho": rho_sj, "p_value": p_sj},
            "structural_beats_surface": rho_sj > rho_fk,
            "rho_advantage": rho_sj - rho_fk,
            "sample_f1_mean": sample_f1_dist["mean"],
            "sample_f1_std": sample_f1_dist["std"],
            "sample_f1_pct_zero": sample_f1_dist["pct_f1_zero"],
        }

    # --- Verdict: RE subtask's structural ρ is the primary signal ---
    re_report = subtask_reports.get("re", subtask_reports.get(args.subtask))
    re_rho = re_report["correlation_softjaccard_vs_f1"]["rho"]
    re_beats = re_report["structural_beats_surface"]
    any_headroom = any(sr["oracle_headroom"] >= 0.02 for sr in subtask_reports.values())

    if re_rho >= 0.40 and re_beats and any_headroom:
        verdict = "PASS"
    elif re_rho >= 0.30:
        verdict = "MARGINAL"
    else:
        verdict = "FAIL"

    # --- Build report ---
    if args.subtask == "joint":
        report = {
            "dataset": args.dataset,
            "subtask": "joint",
            "n_samples": args.n_samples,
            "temperature": args.temperature,
            "num_instances": len(sampled),
            "use_train_format": args.use_train_format,
        }
        for st, st_report in subtask_reports.items():
            for k, v in st_report.items():
                report[f"{st}_{k}"] = v
        report["verdict"] = verdict
        report["verdict_note"] = "Joint mode: verdict requires RE ρ_sj ≥ 0.40 AND ρ_sj > ρ_fk AND any subtask headroom ≥ 2pp"
    else:
        st_report = subtask_reports[args.subtask]
        report = {
            "dataset": args.dataset,
            "subtask": args.subtask,
            "n_samples": args.n_samples,
            "temperature": args.temperature,
            "num_instances": len(sampled),
            "use_train_format": args.use_train_format,
            **st_report,
            "verdict": verdict,
            "verdict_note": "MVP verdict on single subtask; final pass requires at least one of NER/RE/EAE to meet threshold",
        }

    worst_pct_zero = max(sr["sample_f1_pct_zero"] for sr in subtask_reports.values())
    if worst_pct_zero > 30:
        report["warning"] = "⚠️ >30% samples F1=0, recommend re-running at T=0.7"

    print_report(report)

    report_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "report.json")
    with open(report_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"Report saved to {report_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

73	def _token_offsets(tokens: list[str]) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
74	    """Compute (char_start, char_end) for each token when joined by single spaces."""
75	    offsets = []
76	    pos = 0
77	    for tok in tokens:
78	        offsets.append((pos, pos + len(tok)))
79	        pos += len(tok) + 1  # +1 for the space
80	    return offsets
81	
82	
83	def _parse_scierc_sentence(
84	    doc_key: str,
85	    sent_idx: int,
86	    tokens: list[str],
87	    ner_spans: list[list],
88	    rel_spans: list[list],
89	    global_token_offset: int,
90	) -> Instance:
91	    """Convert one SciERC sentence into a UIE Instance.
92	
93	    Args:
94	        doc_key: Document identifier.
95	        sent_idx: Sentence index within the document.
96	        tokens: List of tokens for this sentence.
97	        ner_spans: NER annotations [[start, end, type], ...] with global token indices (inclusive).
98	        rel_spans: Relation annotations [[s1, e1, s2, e2, type], ...] with global token indices.
99	        global_token_offset: Token index of the first token of this sentence in the document.
100	
101	    Returns:
102	        A UIE Instance dict.
103	    """
104	    text = " ".join(tokens)
105	    offsets = _token_offsets(tokens)
106	
107	    def _local(global_idx: int) -> int:
108	        return global_idx - global_token_offset
109	
110	    # --- entities ---
111	    entities: list[Entity] = []
112	    span_to_text: dict[tuple[int, int], str] = {}
113	    for span in ner_spans:
114	        tok_start, tok_end, etype = span[0], span[1], span[2]
115	        local_s, local_e = _local(tok_start), _local(tok_end)
116	        if local_s < 0 or local_e >= len(tokens):
117	            continue
118	        char_start = offsets[local_s][0]
119	        char_end = offsets[local_e][1]
120	        entity_text = text[char_start:char_end]
121	        entities.append(Entity(text=entity_text, type=etype, start=char_start, end=char_end))
122	        span_to_text[(tok_start, tok_end)] = entity_text
123	
124	    # --- relations ---
125	    relations: list[Relation] = []
126	    for span in rel_spans:
127	        s1, e1, s2, e2, rtype = span[0], span[1], span[2], span[3], span[4]
128	        local_s1, local_e1 = _local(s1), _local(e1)
129	        local_s2, local_e2 = _local(s2), _local(e2)
130	        if any(idx < 0 for idx in (local_s1, local_e1, local_s2, local_e2)):
131	            continue
132	        if local_e1 >= len(tokens) or local_e2 >= len(tokens):
133	            continue
134	        head_cs = offsets[local_s1][0]
135	        head_ce = offsets[local_e1][1]
136	        tail_cs = offsets[local_s2][0]
137	        tail_ce = offsets[local_e2][1]
138	        relations.append(Relation(
139	            head=span_to_text.get((s1, e1), text[head_cs:head_ce]),
140	            tail=span_to_text.get((s2, e2), text[tail_cs:tail_ce]),
141	            type=rtype,
142	            head_start=head_cs,
143	            head_end=head_ce,
144	            tail_start=tail_cs,
145	            tail_end=tail_ce,
146	        ))
147	
148	    return Instance(
149	        id=f"{doc_key}_sent{sent_idx:03d}",
150	        text=text,
151	        entities=entities,
152	        relations=relations,
153	        events=[],
154	    )
155

157	def load_scierc(data_dir: str) -> dict[str, list[Instance]]:
158	    """Load SciERC dataset and convert to UIE JSON format.
159	
160	    Args:
161	        data_dir: Path to the SciERC directory containing {train,dev,test}.json.
162	
163	    Returns:
164	        Dict with keys "train", "dev", "test", each mapping to a list of Instance dicts.
165	    """
166	    splits: dict[str, list[Instance]] = {}
167	    for split in ("train", "dev", "test"):
168	        filepath = os.path.join(data_dir, f"{split}.json")
169	        instances: list[Instance] = []
170	        with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
171	            for line in f:
172	                line = line.strip()
173	                if not line:
174	                    continue
175	                doc = json.loads(line)
176	                doc_key = doc["doc_key"]
177	                sentences = doc["sentences"]
178	                ner_all = doc.get("ner", [[] for _ in sentences])
179	                rel_all = doc.get("relations", [[] for _ in sentences])
180	
181	                global_offset = 0
182	                for sent_idx, tokens in enumerate(sentences):
183	                    ner_spans = ner_all[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(ner_all) else []
184	                    rel_spans = rel_all[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(rel_all) else []
185	                    inst = _parse_scierc_sentence(
186	                        doc_key, sent_idx, tokens, ner_spans, rel_spans, global_offset,
187	                    )
188	                    instances.append(inst)
189	                    global_offset += len(tokens)
190	
191	        splits[split] = instances
192	    return splits
193

201	
202	    Args:
203	        data_dir: Path to preprocessed ACE05 directory.
204	        subtask: "ner" for entity extraction (7 types: PER, ORG, GPE, LOC, FAC, WEA, VEH),
205	                 "eae" for event argument extraction (33 event types).
206	
207	    Returns:
208	        Dict with keys "train", "dev", "test".
209	    """
210	    if subtask not in ("ner", "eae"):
211	        raise ValueError(f"subtask must be 'ner' or 'eae', got '{subtask}'")
212	
213	    # TODO: Implement ACE05 parsing once data format is confirmed.
214	    # ACE05 has multiple preprocessing formats (DyGIE++, OneIE, DEGREE, etc.).
215	    # The parsing logic depends on which preprocessed version we use.
216	    raise NotImplementedError(

227	    """Save a list of UIE instances to a JSONL file.
228	
229	    Args:
230	        instances: List of Instance dicts.
231	        output_path: Destination file path.
232	    """
233	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
234	    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
235	        for inst in instances:
236	            f.write(json.dumps(inst, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
237	
238	
239	def load_uie_jsonl(path: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
240	    """Load instances from a JSONL file.
241	
242	    Args:
243	        path: Path to a JSONL file where each line is a JSON instance.
244	
245	    Returns:
246	        List of instance dicts.
247	    """
248	    instances = []
249	    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
250	        for line in f:
251	            line = line.strip()
252	            if line:
253	                instances.append(json.loads(line))
254	    return instances
255	
256	
257	def train_dev_test_split(
258	    instances: list,
259	    train_ratio: float = 0.8,
260	    dev_ratio: float = 0.1,
261	    seed: int = 42,
262	) -> dict[str, list]:
263	    """Split instances into train/dev/test sets.
264	
265	    Args:
266	        instances: List of instances to split.
267	        train_ratio: Fraction for training set.
268	        dev_ratio: Fraction for dev set. Test gets the remainder.
269	        seed: Random seed for reproducibility.
270	
271	    Returns:
272	        Dict with keys "train", "dev", "test".
273	    """
274	    rng = random.Random(seed)
275	    indices = list(range(len(instances)))
276	    rng.shuffle(indices)
277	
278	    n = len(instances)
279	    n_train = int(n * train_ratio)
280	    n_dev = int(n * dev_ratio)
281	
282	    train_idx = indices[:n_train]
283	    dev_idx = indices[n_train:n_train + n_dev]
284	    test_idx = indices[n_train + n_dev:]
285	
286	    return {
287	        "train": [instances[i] for i in train_idx],
288	        "dev": [instances[i] for i in dev_idx],
289	        "test": [instances[i] for i in test_idx],
290	    }

"""Data processing utilities for structured self-consistency IE experiments.

Handles loading, converting, and splitting datasets into the unified UIE JSON format.
Supported datasets: SciERC (fully implemented), ACE05 (interface only).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import random
from typing import Any, TypedDict


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared type definitions (UIE JSON format)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Entity(TypedDict):
    text: str
    type: str
    start: int
    end: int


class Relation(TypedDict):
    head: str
    tail: str
    type: str
    head_start: int
    head_end: int
    tail_start: int
    tail_end: int


class EventArgument(TypedDict):
    text: str
    role: str
    start: int
    end: int


class Trigger(TypedDict):
    text: str
    type: str
    start: int
    end: int


class Event(TypedDict):
    trigger: Trigger
    arguments: list[EventArgument]


class Extraction(TypedDict, total=False):
    entities: list[Entity]
    relations: list[Relation]
    events: list[Event]


class Instance(TypedDict, total=False):
    id: str
    text: str
    entities: list[Entity]
    relations: list[Relation]
    events: list[Event]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SciERC
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _token_offsets(tokens: list[str]) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Compute (char_start, char_end) for each token when joined by single spaces."""
    offsets = []
    pos = 0
    for tok in tokens:
        offsets.append((pos, pos + len(tok)))
        pos += len(tok) + 1  # +1 for the space
    return offsets


def _parse_scierc_sentence(
    doc_key: str,
    sent_idx: int,
    tokens: list[str],
    ner_spans: list[list],
    rel_spans: list[list],
    global_token_offset: int,
) -> Instance:
    """Convert one SciERC sentence into a UIE Instance.

    Args:
        doc_key: Document identifier.
        sent_idx: Sentence index within the document.
        tokens: List of tokens for this sentence.
        ner_spans: NER annotations [[start, end, type], ...] with global token indices (inclusive).
        rel_spans: Relation annotations [[s1, e1, s2, e2, type], ...] with global token indices.
        global_token_offset: Token index of the first token of this sentence in the document.

    Returns:
        A UIE Instance dict.
    """
    text = " ".join(tokens)
    offsets = _token_offsets(tokens)

    def _local(global_idx: int) -> int:
        return global_idx - global_token_offset

    # --- entities ---
    entities: list[Entity] = []
    span_to_text: dict[tuple[int, int], str] = {}
    for span in ner_spans:
        tok_start, tok_end, etype = span[0], span[1], span[2]
        local_s, local_e = _local(tok_start), _local(tok_end)
        if local_s < 0 or local_e >= len(tokens):
            continue
        char_start = offsets[local_s][0]
        char_end = offsets[local_e][1]
        entity_text = text[char_start:char_end]
        entities.append(Entity(text=entity_text, type=etype, start=char_start, end=char_end))
        span_to_text[(tok_start, tok_end)] = entity_text

    # --- relations ---
    relations: list[Relation] = []
    for span in rel_spans:
        s1, e1, s2, e2, rtype = span[0], span[1], span[2], span[3], span[4]
        local_s1, local_e1 = _local(s1), _local(e1)
        local_s2, local_e2 = _local(s2), _local(e2)
        if any(idx < 0 for idx in (local_s1, local_e1, local_s2, local_e2)):
            continue
        if local_e1 >= len(tokens) or local_e2 >= len(tokens):
            continue
        head_cs = offsets[local_s1][0]
        head_ce = offsets[local_e1][1]
        tail_cs = offsets[local_s2][0]
        tail_ce = offsets[local_e2][1]
        relations.append(Relation(
            head=span_to_text.get((s1, e1), text[head_cs:head_ce]),
            tail=span_to_text.get((s2, e2), text[tail_cs:tail_ce]),
            type=rtype,
            head_start=head_cs,
            head_end=head_ce,
            tail_start=tail_cs,
            tail_end=tail_ce,
        ))

    return Instance(
        id=f"{doc_key}_sent{sent_idx:03d}",
        text=text,
        entities=entities,
        relations=relations,
        events=[],
    )


def load_scierc(data_dir: str) -> dict[str, list[Instance]]:
    """Load SciERC dataset and convert to UIE JSON format.

    Args:
        data_dir: Path to the SciERC directory containing {train,dev,test}.json.

    Returns:
        Dict with keys "train", "dev", "test", each mapping to a list of Instance dicts.
    """
    splits: dict[str, list[Instance]] = {}
    for split in ("train", "dev", "test"):
        filepath = os.path.join(data_dir, f"{split}.json")
        instances: list[Instance] = []
        with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                doc = json.loads(line)
                doc_key = doc["doc_key"]
                sentences = doc["sentences"]
                ner_all = doc.get("ner", [[] for _ in sentences])
                rel_all = doc.get("relations", [[] for _ in sentences])

                global_offset = 0
                for sent_idx, tokens in enumerate(sentences):
                    ner_spans = ner_all[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(ner_all) else []
                    rel_spans = rel_all[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(rel_all) else []
                    inst = _parse_scierc_sentence(
                        doc_key, sent_idx, tokens, ner_spans, rel_spans, global_offset,
                    )
                    instances.append(inst)
                    global_offset += len(tokens)

        splits[split] = instances
    return splits


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ACE05 (interface only)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def load_ace05(data_dir: str, subtask: str = "ner") -> dict[str, list[Instance]]:
    """Load ACE05 dataset and convert to UIE JSON format.

    Args:
        data_dir: Path to preprocessed ACE05 directory.
        subtask: "ner" for entity extraction (7 types: PER, ORG, GPE, LOC, FAC, WEA, VEH),
                 "eae" for event argument extraction (33 event types).

    Returns:
        Dict with keys "train", "dev", "test".
    """
    if subtask not in ("ner", "eae"):
        raise ValueError(f"subtask must be 'ner' or 'eae', got '{subtask}'")

    # TODO: Implement ACE05 parsing once data format is confirmed.
    # ACE05 has multiple preprocessing formats (DyGIE++, OneIE, DEGREE, etc.).
    # The parsing logic depends on which preprocessed version we use.
    raise NotImplementedError(
        f"ACE05 loading for subtask='{subtask}' is not yet implemented. "
        "Awaiting data format confirmation."
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generic I/O utilities
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def convert_to_uie_jsonl(instances: list[dict[str, Any]], output_path: str) -> None:
    """Save a list of UIE instances to a JSONL file.

    Args:
        instances: List of Instance dicts.
        output_path: Destination file path.
    """
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for inst in instances:
            f.write(json.dumps(inst, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def load_uie_jsonl(path: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Load instances from a JSONL file.

    Args:
        path: Path to a JSONL file where each line is a JSON instance.

    Returns:
        List of instance dicts.
    """
    instances = []
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                instances.append(json.loads(line))
    return instances


def train_dev_test_split(
    instances: list,
    train_ratio: float = 0.8,
    dev_ratio: float = 0.1,
    seed: int = 42,
) -> dict[str, list]:
    """Split instances into train/dev/test sets.

    Args:
        instances: List of instances to split.
        train_ratio: Fraction for training set.
        dev_ratio: Fraction for dev set. Test gets the remainder.
        seed: Random seed for reproducibility.

    Returns:
        Dict with keys "train", "dev", "test".
    """
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    indices = list(range(len(instances)))
    rng.shuffle(indices)

    n = len(instances)
    n_train = int(n * train_ratio)
    n_dev = int(n * dev_ratio)

    train_idx = indices[:n_train]
    dev_idx = indices[n_train:n_train + n_dev]
    test_idx = indices[n_train + n_dev:]

    return {
        "train": [instances[i] for i in train_idx],
        "dev": [instances[i] for i in dev_idx],
        "test": [instances[i] for i in test_idx],
    }

216	        sampled_instances: List of SampledInstance dicts, each containing

228	    all_sample_f1s: list[float] = []
229	    per_instance: list[dict] = []

234	        f1s = [per_instance_f1(sample, gold, subtask) for sample in samples]
235	        all_sample_f1s.extend(f1s)
236	
237	        if f1s:
238	            n_zero = sum(1 for f in f1s if f == 0.0)
239	            per_instance.append({
240	                "mean": statistics.mean(f1s),
241	                "std": statistics.pstdev(f1s),
242	                "pct_f1_zero": 100.0 * n_zero / len(f1s),
243	                "f1s": f1s,
244	            })
245	        else:
246	            per_instance.append({"mean": 0.0, "std": 0.0, "pct_f1_zero": 100.0, "f1s": []})
247	
248	    if all_sample_f1s:
249	        n_zero_total = sum(1 for f in all_sample_f1s if f == 0.0)
250	        mean = statistics.mean(all_sample_f1s)
251	        std = statistics.pstdev(all_sample_f1s)
252	        pct_f1_zero = 100.0 * n_zero_total / len(all_sample_f1s)
253	    else:
254	        mean = 0.0
255	        std = 0.0
256	        pct_f1_zero = 100.0
257	
258	    return {
259	        "all_sample_f1s": all_sample_f1s,
260	        "mean": mean,
261	        "std": std,
262	        "pct_f1_zero": pct_f1_zero,
263	        "per_instance": per_instance,
264	    }

266	
267	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
268	# Correlation
269	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
270	
271	def spearman_correlation(
272	    scores_a: list[float],
273	    scores_b: list[float],
274	) -> tuple[float, float]:
275	    """Compute Spearman rank correlation between two score lists.
276	
277	    Args:
278	        scores_a: First list of scores.
279	        scores_b: Second list of scores (same length as scores_a).
280	
281	    Returns:
282	        (rho, p_value).
283	    """
284	    if len(scores_a) != len(scores_b):
285	        raise ValueError(
286	            f"Score lists must have equal length, got {len(scores_a)} vs {len(scores_b)}"
287	        )
288	    if len(scores_a) < 3:
289	        return (0.0, 1.0)
290	    result = spearmanr(scores_a, scores_b)
291	    return (float(result.statistic), float(result.pvalue))
292	
293	
294	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
295	# Summary report
296	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
297	
298	def generate_evaluation_report(
299	    sampled_instances: list[dict],
300	    consistency_scores: dict[str, list[float]],
301	    subtask: str = "ner",
302	) -> dict[str, Any]:
303	    """Generate a structured evaluation report.
304	
305	    Computes greedy F1, oracle best-of-N F1, and consistency-F1 correlation
306	    for each consistency scoring method.
307	
308	    Args:
309	        sampled_instances: List of SampledInstance dicts, each containing
310	            "id", "text", "gold" (Extraction), "samples" (list of Extraction),
311	            and optionally "greedy" (Extraction).
312	        consistency_scores: Dict mapping method name to a list of per-instance
313	            consistency scores (aligned with sampled_instances).
314	        subtask: "ner" or "eae".
315	
316	    Returns:
317	        Dict with keys:
318	            - "greedy_f1": float, micro-averaged F1 of greedy outputs.
319	            - "oracle_best_of_n_f1": float, micro-averaged F1 using the
320	              best sample per instance.
321	            - "per_instance_greedy_f1": list of per-instance greedy F1 values.
322	            - "correlations": dict mapping method name to {"rho": float, "p_value": float}.
323	            - "num_instances": int.
324	            - "num_samples_per_instance": float, average number of samples.
325	    """
326	    greedy_preds = []
327	    greedy_golds = []
328	    oracle_preds = []
329	    oracle_golds = []
330	    instance_greedy_f1s: list[float] = []
331	
332	    for inst in sampled_instances:
333	        gold = inst["gold"]
334	
335	        # Greedy F1
336	        greedy = inst.get("greedy")
337	        if greedy is not None:
338	            greedy_preds.append(greedy)
339	            greedy_golds.append(gold)
340	            instance_greedy_f1s.append(per_instance_f1(greedy, gold, subtask))
341	        else:
342	            instance_greedy_f1s.append(0.0)
343	
344	        # Oracle best-of-N: pick the sample with highest per-instance F1
345	        samples = inst.get("samples", [])
346	        if samples:
347	            best_sample = max(samples, key=lambda s: per_instance_f1(s, gold, subtask))
348	            oracle_preds.append(best_sample)
349	            oracle_golds.append(gold)
350	
351	    # Micro-averaged scores
352	    f1_fn = {"ner": compute_ner_f1, "re": compute_re_f1, "eae": compute_eae_f1}[subtask]
353	    greedy_metrics = f1_fn(greedy_preds, greedy_golds) if greedy_preds else _prf(0, 0, 0)
354	    oracle_metrics = f1_fn(oracle_preds, oracle_golds) if oracle_preds else _prf(0, 0, 0)
355	
356	    # Correlation between consistency scores and per-instance greedy F1
357	    correlations: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
358	    for method_name, scores in consistency_scores.items():
359	        rho, p_value = spearman_correlation(scores, instance_greedy_f1s)
360	        correlations[method_name] = {"rho": rho, "p_value": p_value}
361	
362	    total_samples = sum(len(inst.get("samples", [])) for inst in sampled_instances)
363	    n = len(sampled_instances)
364	
365	    return {
366	        "greedy_f1": greedy_metrics["f1"],
367	        "oracle_best_of_n_f1": oracle_metrics["f1"],
368	        "per_instance_greedy_f1": instance_greedy_f1s,
369	        "correlations": correlations,
370	        "num_instances": n,
371	        "num_samples_per_instance": total_samples / n if n > 0 else 0.0,
372	    }
373	
374	
375	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
376	# Internal helpers
377	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
378	
379	def _prf(tp: int, fp: int, fn: int) -> dict[str, float]:
380	    """Compute precision, recall, F1 from raw counts."""
381	    precision = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0.0
382	    recall = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0.0
383	    f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if (precision + recall) > 0 else 0.0
384	    return {"precision": precision, "recall": recall, "f1": f1}
385
